title: How to catch EVERY job opportunity 🔎
description:
If you’ve ever applied to a job and tried to go back to the job description only to find it’s been pulled offline this is where a tool like the Teal Chrome Extension comes to help. When applying for jobs, save them to your Job Tracker to keep all information handy externally. Using the job description to help prepare for an interview is key to success and you want that information handy even if the role has been closed. #jobsearch #jobsearchtips #entrylevel #jobsearching
